notes: «حدثني أبي (رحمه الله)» : the father is a bare relation, and he shares one level with three named co-transmitters («جميعا»)
«أبي عبد الله (ع)» after «عن» is inside the chain, so he is a narrator; the words «قال لي يا معاوية» are addressed to Mu'awiya and are not a link
«حسان البصري» is read as written in the text, not as another source names it
